content: Structure of FMFeatureRelation A FMFeatureRelation R establishes a binary relation between two features: 1. The FMFeature f which aggregates R . 2. The FMFeature f 0 which R refers to in the role feature . A FMFeatureRelation is always directed from f to f 0 . If R refers to features ⌊ f 1 ; f 2 ; : : : ; f n g in the role feature , then R establishes n such binary relations.
